setup: One mixed number is subtracted from another and a whole must be borrowed.

steps.say: The first mixed number is [[w1]] and [[a]]/[[b]], and the second is [[w2]] and [[c]]/[[d]].
Borrow one whole from the whole part and add it to the fraction as [[b]]/[[b]].
After borrowing, the whole part drops by one and the fractional numerator grows by [[b]], so the subtraction can proceed.

answer: So the value asked for is [[answer]].
